The *Kuṇḍapūvajātaka* (Ja 109) is a canonical birth story located in the Jātaka section of the Khuddaka Nikāya. The narrative opens with the verse phrase “As fares his worshipper” and was delivered by the Buddha while residing at Sāvatthī in reference to an impoverished man. The Jātaka has been translated into English under the title *The Cake*.
